name: Ubuntu
description: Most popular Linux distribution with excellent community support and regular updates.
fullDescription: Ubuntu is a free and open-source Linux distribution based on Debian. It is one of the most widely used Linux distributions for both personal computers and servers. Ubuntu provides a user-friendly experience with a beautiful GNOME desktop environment, extensive software repositories, and a large community.
guide: Start with Ubuntu if you're new to Linux. Download the ISO, create a bootable USB, and follow the installation wizard. Ubuntu includes everything you need out of the box.

name: Deepin OS
description: Beautiful and elegant Linux distribution with a stunning UI designed to replace Windows and macOS.
fullDescription: Deepin OS is a Linux distribution created by Deepin Company. It features the Deepin Desktop Environment (DDE), which is known for its stunning visual design, smooth animations, and user-friendly interface. Deepin OS is often compared to macOS for its elegant and polished appearance.
guide: Perfect for macOS users switching to Linux. The interface is intuitive and similar to macOS. Download from deepin.org, create a bootable USB, and enjoy the beautiful DDE experience.

name: Linux Mint
description: Beginner-friendly Linux distribution with focus on out-of-the-box functionality and familiarity.
fullDescription: Linux Mint is a community-driven Linux distribution based on Ubuntu and Debian. It provides out-of-the-box multimedia support and is designed for ease of use. Mint feels like Windows but with Linux's power and freedom.
guide: Great for Windows users. Choose Cinnamon edition for a Windows-like experience. Download, create bootable USB, install, and start using it immediately. Everything is pre-configured.

name: Elementary OS
description: Beautiful and elegant Linux distribution with focus on design and user experience.
fullDescription: Elementary OS is an Ubuntu-based desktop Linux operating system. It is designed to be as fast and power-efficient as possible while maintaining the quality and reliability you expect. The Pantheon desktop environment is inspired by macOS and Windows.
guide: Perfect macOS alternative. Download Elementary OS, create a bootable USB. The interface is clean and intuitive. Install applications through AppCenter for a curated selection.

name: Zorin OS
description: Elegant Linux distribution designed for Windows users transitioning to Linux.
fullDescription: Zorin OS is a desktop operating system designed to look and feel like Windows, making it simple for new users to get started with Linux. It's built on a foundation of Ubuntu and includes many features for Windows users.
guide: Direct Windows alternative. Download and install Zorin OS. It looks and feels like Windows but runs Linux. Perfect for businesses transitioning from Windows.

name: Pop!_OS
description: Fast and free operating system developed by System76 for creators and developers.
fullDescription: Pop!_OS is an operating system for STEM and creative professionals who use their computer as a tool to discover and create. It's a Ubuntu LTS based operating system with a focus on simplicity and productivity.
guide: Great for developers and creators. Download from Pop!_OS website. Install and enjoy a system optimized for productivity. Use keyboard shortcuts for efficiency.

name: Fedora
description: Cutting-edge Linux distribution sponsored by Red Hat with latest technologies.
fullDescription: Fedora is a Linux distribution developed by the community-supported Fedora Project and sponsored primarily by Red Hat. It aims to be on the cutting edge of open source technology and is a proving ground for technologies that may eventually make their way into Red Hat Enterprise Linux.
guide: For those wanting the latest Linux tech. Download Fedora, create bootable USB, and install. Perfect for developers who want to stay on the cutting edge of Linux.

name: Manjaro
description: User-friendly Arch Linux-based distribution with graphical installation tools.
fullDescription: Manjaro is a free and open-source Linux distribution based on the Arch Linux operating system. It provides all the benefits of Arch Linux combined with a focus on user-friendliness and accessibility.
guide: For intermediate users wanting Arch simplicity without complexity. Download, use graphical installer, and enjoy a rolling release system with AUR access for tons of software.

name: Debian
description: One of the oldest and most stable Linux distributions with extensive package support.
fullDescription: Debian is a free operating system for your computer. It comes with over 59,000 packages, pre-compiled software bundled up in a nice format for easy installation. Debian is known for stability and has been around since 1993.
guide: For those valuing stability. Choose a desktop environment during install. Debian is rock-solid and perfect for long-term use without frequent updates.

name: openSUSE
description: Professional-grade Linux distribution with excellent system configuration tools.
fullDescription: openSUSE is a free and Linux-based operating system for your PC, laptop or server. You can surf the web, manage your e-mails and photos, do office work, play videos or music, and much more. For developers and sysadmins, openSUSE includes powerful tools for development and system administration.
guide: Great for system administrators. Features YaST tool for configuration. Download, install with KDE Plasma desktop for best experience.

name: Arch Linux
description: Lightweight and flexible Linux distribution for experienced users.
fullDescription: Arch Linux is an independently developed Linux distribution for computers based on the x86-64 architecture. It is composed predominantly of free and open-source software. Arch Linux follows a rolling release model.
guide: For Linux experts only. Manual installation teaches you Linux. Follow the ArchWiki guide carefully. Takes time but gives you complete control.

name: Linux Lite
description: Extremely lightweight Linux distribution perfect for old computers and minimal systems.
fullDescription: Linux Lite is a free, easy-to-use Linux distribution based on Ubuntu. It is designed to make the transition from Windows to Linux as smooth as possible. Lite means it's lightweight - perfect for older computers.
guide: Perfect for breathing life into old computers. Download, install on old hardware, and get a fast, responsive system. Great alternative to Windows for aging machines.

name: Lubuntu
description: Lightweight Ubuntu variant using LXQt desktop environment for minimal resource usage.
fullDescription: Lubuntu is a fast and lightweight operating system built on top of Ubuntu. It uses the minimal LXQt desktop environment and is designed for older computers and those who prefer a minimal system.
guide: For older computers or low-resource systems. Download Lubuntu, install on your old machine. You'll have a fast, responsive Linux system.

name: KDE Neon
description: Ubuntu-based distribution featuring the latest KDE Plasma desktop with bleeding-edge features.
fullDescription: KDE Neon is not a traditional Linux distribution. Instead, it is the latest and greatest KDE Plasma and KDE Frameworks running on top of an LTS Ubuntu base. It combines the latest KDE software with Ubuntu's reliability.
guide: For KDE Plasma lovers. Get the latest features on Ubuntu base. Download, install, and enjoy the beautiful and powerful KDE Plasma desktop.

name: Solus
description: Independent distribution with its own package manager and beautiful Budgie desktop environment.
fullDescription: Solus is an independent Linux distribution created by the Ikey Doherty. It is self-contained with its own package manager called Eopkg. Solus features the beautiful Budgie desktop environment designed for simplicity and elegance.
guide: For users wanting something different. Solus with Budgie is modern and beautiful. Download, install, and enjoy a fresh take on Linux desktop.

name: Xubuntu
description: Ubuntu-based distribution with the lightweight Xfce desktop environment.
fullDescription: Xubuntu is an elegant and easy-to-use operating system. It comes with Xfce, which is a stable, light and configurable desktop environment. Xubuntu is perfect for older machines or those who prefer a lightweight desktop.
guide: Perfect balance between lightweight and feature-rich. Download Xubuntu, install, and enjoy a responsive system with Ubuntu's stability.

name: CentOS
description: Stable and reliable Linux distribution for enterprise and server deployments.
fullDescription: CentOS is a Linux distribution that provides a free, community-supported computing platform functionally compatible with its upstream source Red Hat Enterprise Linux. It is widely used in enterprise environments.
guide: For server deployment and enterprise use. CentOS provides rock-solid stability. Perfect for production environments requiring long-term support.

name: Kali Linux
description: Specialized Linux distribution for penetration testing and security research.
fullDescription: Kali Linux is a Debian-derived Linux distribution designed for digital forensics and penetration testing. It is maintained and funded by Offensive Security. Kali comes with hundreds of pre-installed penetration testing tools.
guide: For cybersecurity professionals only. Kali comes with 600+ penetration testing tools. Use legally and ethically for authorized testing only.

name: AlmaLinux
description: Free, open-source, production-ready Linux distribution compatible with RHEL.
fullDescription: AlmaLinux is a stable, predictable, and manageable Linux ecosystem. It benefits the open source community by providing a stable platform to build upon with long-term support. It's a community-driven project backed by the Cloud Infrastructure Services.
guide: RHEL-compatible server OS. Great alternative to CentOS. Download, install on your server, and enjoy production-ready stability.

name: Rocky Linux
description: Community-driven enterprise operating system designed to be 100% bug-for-bug compatible with RHEL.
fullDescription: Rocky Linux is a community enterprise operating system designed for production use. It is backed by Gregory Kurtzer, who founded the original CentOS project. Rocky is 100% compatible with RHEL.
guide: Enterprise server OS created by CentOS founder. Perfect RHEL replacement. Install and deploy for production environments.

name: Kubuntu
description: Ubuntu-based distribution featuring the powerful and beautiful KDE Plasma desktop.
fullDescription: Kubuntu is a free, complete, and open-source operating system that uses KDE Plasma. It combines Ubuntu's stability with KDE's power and features. Kubuntu is perfect for those who want a feature-rich desktop.
guide: For those wanting powerful KDE Plasma on Ubuntu base. Download Kubuntu, install, and enjoy extensive customization and features.

name: Ubuntu MATE
description: Ubuntu-based distribution with the classic and lightweight MATE desktop environment.
fullDescription: Ubuntu MATE is a stable, easy-to-use operating system with a configurable desktop. The MATE desktop environment is the continuation of GNOME 2. Ubuntu MATE is perfect for older computers.
guide: Perfect for older hardware or those who love classic interfaces. Download, install, and enjoy a lightweight Ubuntu experience.
